findings.problem: The kernel-bound proofs in this file are repeated line for line in another file, so the same machinery is maintained twice. The other file is lean/OAI/MeasureTheory/FalconerCompletion/Graphs/DiagonalBinMassLe.lean, in namespace `GraphLiteralSupport.Attempt4FarGrid`. The repeated parts are: (1) the proof of `realBin_kernel_bound`, which covers the floor/bin inequalities, the `|(i-j)+1/2| ≤ 2(1+|x-y|/w)` step, and the final nlinarith; (2) the Tonelli-style argument in `weighted_offset_kernel_bound`, which swaps `lintegral_tsum`, evaluates the indicators, and applies `ennreal_offset_cauchy`; (3) the `le_tsum` chain in `real_bin_decaying_kernel_bound`; and (4) `half_le_abs_int_add_half` and `binKernelConstant_ne_top`. The copy also redefines `realBin`, `binL2Norm`, `ennreal_offset_cauchy` and `realBin_cover`, which duplicate Geometry/Bins.lean and Geometry/BinOffsets.lean. The two copies can drift apart: a fix or strengthening to one proof, such as a different constant or a changed summability argument, would have to be made twice. The duplicated `realBin` is also a different object from `PlanarFalconer.realBin`, so results about the two copies cannot be combined without conversion.
findings.proposed_change: Keep the proofs in this file as the single shared home, since this file is already imported by DiagonalBinMassLe.lean. In DiagonalBinMassLe.lean, delete the copied declarations. These are `realBin`, `realBin_measurable`, `realBin_disjoint`, `realBin_diameter`, `real_bin_collision_bound`, `binL2Norm`, `ennreal_offset_cauchy`, `realBin_cover`, `offset_rectangles_mass_le`, `finite_offset_rectangles_mass_le`, `half_le_abs_int_add_half`, `realBin_kernel_bound`, `binKernelWeight`, `binKernelConstant`, `binKernelConstant_ne_top`, `weighted_offset_kernel_bound`, `real_bin_decaying_kernel_bound` and the copied `diagonal_bin_mass_le`. Then add `open OAI.PlanarFalconer` (or `open PlanarFalconer`, since the file is inside `namespace OAI`) in the later `Attempt4FullFar` section. The existing uses there, such as `mixed_bin_collisionND` applying `real_bin_decaying_kernel_bound`, `binKernelConstant` and `real_bin_collision_bound`, then resolve to the shared lemmas under their actual hypotheses `[IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hw : 0 < w)`. The `Attempt4FarGrid` namespace and all other files that qualify these names would need their references redirected the same way. Optionally, within this file, factor the four-line bin-membership conversion in `realBin_kernel_bound` into one lemma `x ∈ realBin w i → (i:ℝ) ≤ x/w ∧ x/w < i+1` and use it for both `hi` and `hj`.
findings.benefit: One authoritative copy of roughly 90 lines of nontrivial analysis (the decaying-kernel bound via offset-rectangle Cauchy–Schwarz) removes the risk of divergent edits. It also unifies the two incompatible `realBin` definitions, so downstream results use a single bin type. Readers no longer have to diff two identical proofs to see whether they differ.
